learning_outcomes.text: To understand the role of the cutting tool in metal cutting and the effects of cutting parameters on the cutting tool.
To be able to select the appropriate cutting tool and determine the factors affecting cutting tool selection.
To acquire knowledge for designing suitable cutting tools and to reduce cutting tool costs.

syllabus_topics: Structures and mechanical behaviors of materials
Metal cutting mechanics and chip formation
Cutting tool angles and their effects on cutting, chip breakers in cutters and chip breaker designs
Cutting forces in metal cutting, factors affecting cutting forces, force measurement and calculation
Heat generation in metal cutting, factors affecting heat generation and its control
Tool wear and its measurement, tool wear mechanisms and wear types
Wear types, tool life and tool life models
Cutting tool materials (High Speed Steel, Cemented Carbide Cutting tools and the effects of their composition on cutting performance)
Cutting tool materials (Cermets, Ceramics, Cubic Boron Nitride – CBN, Polycrystalline Diamond – PCD, Special Cutting Tools)
Cutting tool coating technology, classification of cutting tool materials and ISO code keys for inserts
Tool holders, ISO code keys for tool holders and selection of holders
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated with the midterm exam contributing 40% and the final exam contributing 60%. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate decision according to the academic calendar.
